description: This file contains React components and utility functions for rendering links, attachments, trace links, and managing URL search parameters within a test report UI. It includes components like Link, AttachmentLink, TraceLink, and hooks for URL parameter handling.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: React component that conditionally renders children based on URL search parameters.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: React component for rendering clickable links with custom navigation behavior.

classes.name: ProjectLink
classes.description: Component for linking to a specific project within the test report.

classes.name: AttachmentLink
classes.description: Component for rendering links to test attachments, supporting download and preview.

classes.name: TraceLink
classes.description: Component for linking to trace attachments associated with test results.

classes.name: SearchParamsProvider
classes.description: Context provider for managing URL search parameters.

classes.name: Anchor
classes.description: Component that scrolls into view when anchored via URL parameters.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Programmatically updates browser history and dispatches a popstate event.

methods.name: useSearchParams
methods.description: Hook to access current URL search parameters.

methods.name: useAnchor
methods.description: Hook to handle scrolling to an element when it is anchored via URL.

methods.name: useIsAnchored
methods.description: Hook to determine if a given ID is currently anchored.

methods.name: generateTraceUrl
methods.description: Creates a URL for trace attachments.

methods.name: downloadFileNameForAttachment
methods.description: Generates a filename for downloading an attachment.

methods.name: testResultHref
methods.description: Constructs a URL hash for linking to specific test results and anchors.
